originalTitle: S&P 500, Dow Gain As Earnings Season Sets In, While SpaceX Aids Nasdaq After-Hours — SPCX, BA, MMM, NFLX, QCOM In Focus
summary: SpaceX reported solid earnings fueled by a big jump in its artificial-intelligence business.
content: The S&P 500 ended Tuesday 0.3% higher, the Nasdaq 100 slipped 0.1%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 1%.SpaceX posted $4.4 billion in net income for the quarter ending September. 3M beat earnings expectations for the September quarter and raised its full-year guidance.The S&P 500 and Dow Jones index ended higher on Tuesday as investors braced for the start of earnings season, with 3M shares helping the Dow and strong SpaceX earnings pushing the Nasdaq after hours after a robust earnings print.The S&P 500 ended Tuesday 0.3% higher, the Nasdaq 100 slipped 0.1%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 1%. The Russell 2000, which tracks small-cap stocks, ended 1.7% higher.Futures tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.1%. S&P 500 futures gained 0.4% and Nasdaq-100 futures added nearly 1%.The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) rose 0.6%, and the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) added 1%. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq-100 tracking Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) eased 0.1% on Tuesday. Meanwhile, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and the iShares Semiconductor ETF slipped about 0.4% on Tuesday amid weakness in Micron Tech (MU), Nvidia (NVDA), Broadcom (AVGO), and most other silicon makers. The broader Vanguard Information Technology ETF (VGT) dropped 0.1%.However, all the above tech and semiconductor ETFs recovered after-hours.Retail sentiment on Stocktwits for SPY and DIA was ‘bearish’ with ‘high’ message volumes, while sentiment improved to ‘neutral’ from ‘bearish’ for the QQQ.US Market DriversIndexMoveCloseDow Jones Industrial Average1% 52,495.88 S&P 5000.3%7,712.57Nasdaq 100-0.1%29,490.28The Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed higher behind impressive quarterly reports. Shares of conglomerate 3M advanced over 5% after topping Wall Street estimates and lifting its full-year outlook. Defense contractor Northrop Grumman climbed more than 4% following a quarter that surpassed expectations.At the same time, crude prices retreated, lifting market mood. Domestic West Texas Intermediate futures eased 1.8% to close at $101.79 per barrel, whereas Brent crude futuresdipped 0.7% to $108.79, also aiding the Dow.Meanwhile, SpaceX reported third-quarter revenue of $14.58 billion, compared to an estimated $13 billion, and earnings of $0.35 a share, against an expected $0.13. Furthermore, SpaceX and Tesla formed special committees of independent directors to explore a potential combination, CEO of both companies Elon Musk said on Tuesday during SpaceX’s third-quarter earnings call amid heightened market speculation. The rocket maker’s strong earnings helped push the Nasdaq up 1% after-hours.The key question is whether recent growth rates can be sustained as comparisons become more demanding and macroeconomic risks persist, according to Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi at UBS Chief Investment Office.“We expect a strong third-quarter tech earnings season from a fundamental perspective, but elevated expectations may lead to company-specific volatility,” Burchardi told Bloomberg.Key Trending StocksClaude maker Anthropic is gearing up for a blockbuster initial public offering that could value the firm at up to $2 trillion, according to confidential draft prospectus documents viewed by The Wall Street Journal. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on Tuesday certified Boeing’s (BA) 737 MAX 10, clearing the largest version of the jet family for production and delivery after years of delays and safety concerns.Netflix Inc.(NFLX) on Tuesday reported third-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street expectations, but its shares fell 5% in after-hours trading after the streaming firm issued a soft revenue outlook for the fourth quarter, setting it up for the fourth consecutive period of decelerating sales growth.Kroger Co.(KR) is committing $5 billion to sharpen its value proposition, slash everyday grocery costs, and capture a larger share of the household budget.Qualcomm (QCOM) is preparing to downsize its global workforce through a performance-focused reduction strategy, Reuters reported on Tuesday.Read More: Anthropic’s New Prospectus Shows Revenue Is Growing Fast, So Are Its Compute Costs, Losses And AI Risks: ReportFor updates and corrections, email newsroom[at]stocktwits[dot]com.
chineseTitle: 标准普尔 500 指数、道琼斯指数随着财报季节的到来而上涨，而 SpaceX 则帮助纳斯达克盘后交易——SPCX、BA、MMM、NFLX、QCOM 成为焦点
chineseSummary: SpaceX 报告称，由于其人工智能业务的大幅增长，盈利稳健。
chineseContent: 标准普尔 500 指数周二收高 0.3%，纳斯达克 100 指数下跌 0.1%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 1%。SpaceX 公布截至 9 月底的季度净利润为 44 亿美元。 3M 超出了 9 月份季度的盈利预期，并上调了全年指引。标普 500 指数和道琼斯指数周二收高，因投资者为财报季节的开始做好准备，3M 股票帮助道琼斯指数上涨，SpaceX 强劲的盈利在公布强劲的财报后盘后推动纳斯达克指数上涨。标普 500 指数周二收高 0.3%，纳斯达克 100 指数下跌 0.1%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 1%。追踪小盘股的罗素 2000 指数收盘上涨 1.7%。与道琼斯工业平均指数相关的期货上涨 0.1%。标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.4%，纳斯达克 100 指数期货上涨近 1%。SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) 上涨 0.6%，SPDR 道琼斯工业平均指数 ETF (DIA) 上涨 1%。与此同时，追踪 Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) 的纳斯达克 100 指数周二下跌 0.1%。与此同时，由于美光科技 (MU)、英伟达 (NVDA)、博通 (AVGO) 和大多数其他芯片制造商表现疲软，VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) 和 iShares Semiconductor ETF 周二下跌约 0.4%。更广泛的 Vanguard 信息技术 ETF (VGT) 下跌 0.1%。然而，上述所有科技和半导体 ETF 盘后均恢复。Stocktwits 上的零售情绪对 SPY 和 DIA 为“看跌”，消息量“高”，而 QQQ 的情绪从“看跌”改善为“中性”。美国市场驱动因素指数移动收盘道琼斯工业平均指数 1% 52,495.88 S&P 5000.3%7,712.57纳斯达克100-0.1%29,490.28道琼斯工业平均指数在令人印象深刻的季度报告推动下走高。综合企业 3M 股价上涨超过 5%，超出华尔街预期并全面提升
